Murdle Jr.’s Curious Crimes for Curious Minds: Ready, Set, Solve!

Saturday Oct 10th, 2026
1:30 PM
-
2:30 PM
Special Event
 Lumen Center, Gilman School, 5407 Roland Ave.

Whodunit? That is for you to determine. Join us as we solve a crime and save the world! Jump into a nefarious world full of mystery and mayhem, created by bestselling author of the Murdle Jr. series, G.T. Karber. Participate in this bestselling logic puzzling phenomenon for Junior Detectives and their families. With kid-friendly challenges, riddles and secrets galore, Karber and Charm City Books are counting on you to unravel the clues and close the case!

This is a ticketed event, with copies of the Murdle Jr. novel, Sleuths on the Loose, bundled with each ticket and all the Murdle Jr. puzzle books available for sale. For ticket information, follow the links below! Or sponsor a ticket for a public school student to attend!

Lenna Jawdat (70,000) & Leena Aboutaleb (Thalassa) Dual Author Launch Talk

Saturday Oct 10th, 2026
6:30 PM
-
8:00 PM
Author Events
 The Bookshop!

Join us Oct 10th for a double launch event of Lenna Jawdat's 70,000 & Leena Aboutaleb's Thalassa.

Lenna Jawdat is a poet, writer, and psychotherapist of Palestinian and Iraqi descent. Her work has been published in Poet Lore, The Massachusetts Review, and elsewhere. She was a 2021 Best of the Net nom, a Tin House Workshop alum (2021, 2022, 2024), and artist in residence at Sundress Academy for the Arts (2023). Her debut book, 70,000: Poems, was chosen for the SU/Fall 2026 Indies Introduce & July 2026 Indies Next by the ABA. She lives in DC on the ancestral lands of the Nacotchtank & Piscataway peoples.

leena aboutaleb is an Egyptian and Palestinian writer who asks you to commit to the Palestinian liberation struggle. She is the author of THALASSA (Game Over Books, 2026). Her pamphlet, Expeditions of Projection, was released in 2023 (VIBE). She is a Brooklyn Poets fellow, a Kundiman fellow and McCormick Writing Center scholar.

Once In A Timeline Author Talk w/ Iman Hariri-Kia

Wednesday Oct 14th, 2026
6:30 PM
-
8:00 PM
Author Events
 The Bookshop!

Bestselling author, journalist, and Sounds Like a Cult co-host Iman Hariri-Kia joins Charm City Books to celebrate the release of ONCE IN A TIMELINE, a sexy, laugh-out-loud speculative rom-com about an aspiring New York City lifestyle influencer who becomes trapped inside her own "day in the life" video. Blending swoony romance with sharp commentary on internet culture, identity, and authenticity, ONCE IN A TIMELINE is perfect for fans of Ashley Poston and The Love of My Afterlife.

This is a ticketed, book-bundled event that includes a conversation with B.K. Borison, an audience Q&A, and a book signing. Each ticket comes with a copy of Once in a Timeline.

Bird Girl Author Talk w/ Duston Spear

Saturday Oct 17th, 2026
5:00 PM
-
6:30 PM
 The Bookshop!

Please join us for a discussion between two women artists as they discuss a novel about women in the art world. Presented on the occasion of the publishing of Bird Girl, the debut novel by artist and author Duston Spear, this discussion dives further into the themes that drive the story. The discussion places Spear in conversation with fellow artist Mary Gagler, co-founder and director of Red Giant Gallery and Artist Studios where a concurrent exhibition featuring Spear's art created from the perspective of her protagonist opens on Friday, October 16 from 6-8pm.

Join us for the author talk at Charm City Books on Saturday, then walk down the street to Red Giant Gallery at 403 N Paca for drinks and further dialogue.

Stone Mad Author Talk w/ D.M. Pulley

Thursday Oct 29th, 2026
6:30 PM
-
8:00 PM
Author Events
 The Bookshop!

We are hosting D M Pulley the thriller, horror writer of your dreams! This spooky season travel to an abandon haunted house in part ghost story and part thriller, STONE MAD. The perfect readfor fans of THE BROKEN GIRLS by Simone St. James and MEXICAN GOTHIC by Silvia Moreno-Garcia. The novel follows Mannie Wallace a troubled engineer who investigates a haunted house, uncovering a dark connection between its ghosts and the little girl she lost years ago that might just cost her everything.

Fast paced and a page turner, it will give you the feeling of Shirley Jackson’s “Haunting of Hill House” keeping you on the edge of your seat.
